answer: Audits are recorded in pigment, queued in mirror, and ember publishes the wait time. No identity is paid before an independent audit confirms its history, and the audit queue runs at most 15 identities per epoch. A farm of 354 fresh keys hence waits many epochs for its first payout, which is dead capital for the whole period. A farm of 1680 identities would post 3565 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. Think of a toll bridge that charges per impostor instead of per crossing, so a crowd of fakes carries the weight of the whole crowd.
